subject: USAGE clause
notes: kb/Work PB542 (wave 42) - RE-MEASURED, THE HOLE IS CLOSED. This row recorded the worst-behaved shape in its part: 'MOVE P TO X' with 01 X PIC X(8) COMPILED, RAN, and stored the .NET type name - SET P TO NULL / MOVE P TO X / DISPLAY X printed X=[WiseOwl.Cobol], the first eight characters of 'WiseOwl.Cobol.Runtime.ManagedPointer' - and 'MOVE P TO N' died in the backend as a raw CS1503. Both were re-run on this worktree's own build at --std 2002 and 2023 and both now draw COBOL0809, which quotes SR9's own sentence ('may be referenced explicitly only in a CALL statement, an INITIALIZE statement, an INVOKE statement, a SET statement, a relation condition, a procedure division header, the argument list of an inline invocation of a method, as an argument in a function-identifier, in the RETURNING phrase of an ALLOCATE statement, or in a FREE statement') beside 14.9.25.3 SR1 and 8.5.2.1 Table 2. The landing was kb/Work PB416 + PB423, whose two negatives pb423-move-pointer-sender and pb423-move-pointer-receiver pin both operand positions. Every PERMITTED context this row already measured still works: SET P TO NULL, INITIALIZE P, FREE P, ALLOCATE 8 CHARACTERS RETURNING P, FUNCTION LENGTH(P) and a relation condition; the other prohibitions (DISPLAY P, ADD 1 TO P) are unchanged.
